title: kaiak usage totals
description: The control plane's usage totals as one gateway gets them: the data of a totals event on that gateway's stream, the only way totals travel. A consistent snapshot: its windows include every batch the control plane had counted when it read them, and no other. Every scope and type, whatever the config: the first totals on a stream list every hour and month window with usage in the control plane's current window (a window not listed has used nothing there); each later one lists only the windows that changed since the stream's last totals (a window not listed keeps its value). Per-minute limits are not listed (each gateway enforces its share locally).

live_gateways.description: Gateways in the live set. Each divides its per-minute limits by this count (at least 1), and enforces its share of every backend max_in_flight cap: ceil(max_in_flight / live_gateways), at least 1.

counted_through.description: For the stream's gateway instance, the last usage batch the control plane has counted in each epoch it still keeps a batch cursor for, one entry per epoch (message rule counted-through-epoch-duplicate), in no particular order; empty before its first. Included in the windows: the gateway stops counting each named batch and every earlier one of its epoch as its own.

batch_position.description: A batch within its gateway's epochs: the epoch and the sequence (usage-batch.schema.json, batch_id).

window.description: One scope's current window for one type: the scope (group or global) and type, whether or not the scope has a limit of that type, the window start and the amount used.

group.description: The group whose usage it counts. Absent for global.

type.description: Limit types counted by the control plane: fixed UTC hours and calendar months.

window_start.description: Start of the window, UTC: the top of an hour for tokens_per_hour, the first of a month for usd_per_month.

used.description: tokens_per_hour: tokens (tokens_in + tokens_cache_write + tokens_out; input read from the cache does not count); usd_per_month: nano-USD.
